description: Zero‑dependency, type‑safe Node.js framework that feels like Express, runs at Fastify speed, and is AI‑ready for edge & serverless workloads.
npm_trending_strategy: v0.0.144‑daily.20260925 ships fresh every day with built‑in AI/LLM helpers, native OpenTelemetry tracing, and first‑class support for the hottest runtimes (Node, Deno, Bun, WASM). It delivers Express‑style ergonomics, Fastify‑class performance, and zero runtime dependencies, making it the go‑to choice for edge‑first, serverless, and AI‑augmented services in 2026.
download_hooks: Developers choose Yantravese because it gives Express‑style simplicity **without** any dependency bloat, letting you ship instantly to Cloudflare Workers, Deno Deploy, or Bun.
Benchmark tests show sub‑millisecond routing latency and up to 2× throughput over Fastify on edge V8 isolates, thanks to zero‑dependency ESM core and native HTTP/3 support.

Full TypeScript type safety, built‑in OpenTelemetry, and out‑of‑the‑box AI/LLM utilities turn complex serverless or edge‑AI projects into a few lines of code, dramatically improving developer velocity.
